svg.title: Sovereign — for dark backgrounds
svg.desc: Vector reconstruction from the locked screenshot: open circular sweep, amber four-point star, five original dots, and outlined Sovereign wordmark. Transparent canvas.
svg.metadata: Reference SHA-256: 6e10cf5be2ade1688e5829ff66ab7543ba9115e10d3814ff5a8b88018dc3ac16. All wordmark glyphs are editable paths traced from the reference. No font dependency, embedded image, background, filter, or glow.
